name: stintradio
description: StintRadio: a race engineer on the team radio while you drive Le Mans Ultimate - braking countdowns, lap debriefs, the corner costing you most and why, habit coaching (gears, short-shifting, braking points) and race gaps, in your own ElevenLabs voice or the Windows voice. References come from the class leader, your own best lap or your Coach Dave laps.
